title: Polynomial-size circuits exceed polynomial time
statement: There is a language of binary strings recognized by a family of Boolean circuits with fan-in at most two and size at most $a(n+1)^k$ on inputs of length $n$, for some natural numbers $a,k$, that is not decidable by any deterministic finite Turing machine in time at most $c(n^d+1)$ for any natural numbers $c,d$.
